name: Enrolled students
definition: Students enrolled at the school on the October 1 count, by grade and student group
aggregation: sum across schools; never sum grade ALL with grade rows
breaks: Coverage break between 2013-14 and 2014-15: files for 2009-10 to 2013-14 cover district schools only (131,894 students in 2013-14); from 2014-15 they include charter and alternative schools (197,694). Do not draw a trend line across that break without labeling it. 2014-15 to 2018-19 files were reposted in Aug 2025 under new suppression rules. 2010-11 Black, Hispanic, American Indian, and multiracial counts are withheld (zeros in the source; corrections/enrollment.csv).
usage_notes: Groups under the district's threshold are suppressed (2009-10 to 2013-14: whole rows with 20 or fewer students). Economically disadvantaged counts exist only for 2012-13 and 2013-14 and use a different method from the later CEP rate.

name: Economically disadvantaged rate (CEP)
definition: Share of students the district counts as economically disadvantaged under the federal Community Eligibility Provision method
breaks: CEP direct-certification method; not comparable to free/reduced lunch counts from other places
usage_notes: A poverty proxy. Do not use alone to rank or label schools.

name: Students by catchment and school
definition: Students who live in a catchment (by last address on file at the Oct 1 snapshot) and are enrolled at a given school
usage_notes: Catchment 'not available' means the address could not be placed; destinations outside the district list are placeholder schools (cyber and out-of-city charters).

name: Building capacity
definition: Seats the district counts for the school's building
aggregation: sum per building, not per school (co-located schools share a building)
breaks: Facilities planning capacity figures have shifted between releases
usage_notes: Check co-location before comparing; see facilities data gaps.

name: Total enrollment (retention file)
definition: Total students enrolled at the school as reported in the district's catchment retention file
usage_notes: May differ slightly from enrollment_count totals because of snapshot and program rules.

name: Catchment size
definition: Students living in the school's catchment who are enrolled in any public school (district, charter, or cyber)
aggregation: not aggregable across levels (ES, MS, HS catchments overlap)
usage_notes: Only neighborhood (catchment) schools have catchments.

name: Catchment students attending
definition: Students who live in the school's catchment and attend the school
usage_notes: Numerator of both retention percentages.

name: Enrollment to catchment ratio
definition: School enrollment divided by catchment size
usage_notes: High values can mean a small catchment or many students from elsewhere.

name: Share of catchment students who attend
definition: Catchment students attending the school as a percent of all students living in the catchment
aggregation: recompute from counts; do not average
usage_notes: Denominator is residents, not enrollment. Citywide (sum of attending over sum of catchment size, this project's calculation): 47.4% in 2016-17, 38.1% to 38.8% from 2021-22 to 2025-26.

name: Share of enrollment from the catchment
definition: Catchment students attending the school as a percent of the school's enrollment
aggregation: recompute from counts; do not average
usage_notes: Denominator is the school's enrollment, not catchment residents.

name: Public school students living in the neighborhood (estimate)
definition: Students living in catchments, spread over neighborhoods by where each catchment's 2020 population lives (catchment_flow_to_neighborhood_v1)
aggregation: sum across neighborhoods (not exactly additive to citywide because of unplaced students)
breaks: 2016-17 and 2017-18 have many more students with unplaced addresses (15,735 and 27,911 vs about 2,000 recently), so early estimates undercount
usage_notes: Estimate, not a count. Under 20 is suppressed.

name: Neighborhood students attending their catchment school (estimate)
definition: Of resident students, those enrolled at the school whose catchment they live in (catchment_flow_to_neighborhood_v1)
breaks: 2016-17 and 2017-18 have many more students with unplaced addresses (15,735 and 27,911 vs about 2,000 recently), so early estimates undercount
usage_notes: Estimate. Under 20 is suppressed.

name: Share of neighborhood students attending their catchment school (estimate)
definition: attending_catchment_school_est divided by resident_students_est
breaks: 2016-17 and 2017-18 have many more students with unplaced addresses (15,735 and 27,911 vs about 2,000 recently), so early estimates undercount
usage_notes: Suppressed when the numerator is under 20. Describes family choices and seat availability together; not a measure of school quality.
